ModMetaData.name: Performance Fish Reforjed
ModMetaData.author: DGZ
ModMetaData.description:
A from-scratch reimplementation for RimWorld 1.6 of the optimizations from the original Performance Fish mod, written by the Reforjed series.
It takes the optimization catalog of Performance Fish (bradson, github.com/bbradson/Performance-Fish) as a reference, but rewrites the code against the current 1.6 APIs, replacing obsolete or removed methods. Original code; credit to the original author in CREDITS.md.
Requires Harmony and Prepatcher.
